svg.title: Reading Shelf milestone 3: archive and restore
svg.desc: Six-perspective overview. Green marks new subjects: three reader intentions, the archive-mark rule, two capabilities, the archived_at column, and new checks for hiding, archive rules, the restart round trip, kept memberships and the v2 upgrade. Blue marks changed subjects: the one-article-per-link rule, library page, Flask app, SQLite library, page script, Articles API, Library store, Library JSON API, schema migration and schema version. Gray marks context: the article row, memberships, and earlier milestone tests.
svg.text: Reading Shelf milestone 3: archive and restore
Proposed change • Archiving marks the article; restoring clears the mark, so link, note, status and collections come back.
